items.headline: NFL Week 1 uniforms: Vikings rocking throwbacks, Bengals go orange
items.description: The NFL is back, and so are the uniform combinations. Here's a look at what each team is wearing in Week 1.

items.headline: Jalen Brunson becomes the latest notable athlete to host 'Saturday Night Live'
items.description: There have been 35 athletes to host the sketch comedy staple, including greats such as Peyton Manning, Derek Jeter and LeBron James.

items.headline: Chiefs OC son's case to proceed after mental evaluation
items.description: Elijah Bieniemy's criminal case in the alleged shooting of his mother is moving forward after a psychological evaluation determined that he is competent to receive counsel and understand the charges against him.

items.headline: Predicting the 2026 NFL playoff field, plus Super Bowl pick
items.description: Which teams from last season's playoffs will return -- and which ones will miss out? Who will be the surprises in the bracket? And who will win the Super Bowl?

items.headline: Chiefs to be without left tackle Josh Simmons
items.description: Nate Taylor reports on the Chiefs being without left tackle Josh Simmons in Week 1 vs. the Broncos and who will fill his position.

items.headline: Allen, Jackson, Burrow lead MVP faves; non-QBs lead OROY odds
items.description: Quarterbacks Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Joe Burrow lead an early list of NFL MVP favorites, while RB Jeremiyah Love and WR Carnell Tate top Offensive Rookie of the Year odds.
